verdict.rationale: Gumroad documents a public REST API for products, sales, subscribers and licenses, plus OAuth and MCP access so an agent can manage products and payouts. This gives a first-party headless, programmatic way to automate the product. However, nothing documents CI usage, a CLI, or API tokens for non-interactive pipelines, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec or machine-readable API docs. Missing for 10: documented CI/headless workflow, CLI or service-token auth for pipelines, OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of automated use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: public REST API for products, sales, subscribers, and licenses
OAuth + MCP so an agent can list sales, draft and edit a product, add the files and links buyers receive and a cover image, publish it, and check payouts for a connected creator
